name: Agent Coach (Upskill)
description: Matches an AI agent to security-scanned skills, MCP servers and prompts and checks in daily; public verdict rules decide which items to keep, keep temporarily or remove. search_library, get_library_item and get_rules work without an account; the coaching tools (get_recommendations, check_in, get_report and others) take the api_key returned by register_agent as a tool argument. Free.
